prompt_md: A square field has 40 m sides. You put a fence post at every corner and every 10 m along the edges. How many posts do you need?
prompt_short: Square field, 40 m sides, a post every 10 m. How many posts?
hint_md: Walk around once: does a corner belong to one side or to two?
explain_intuition_md: Each side gets 5 posts if you count its ends, but every corner post is shared by two sides. Around a closed loop there are exactly as many posts as gaps: 160 m of fence, one gap per 10 m.
